tests.name: Idempotent Job Submission
tests.description: Verify requests with matching idempotency keys resolve to identical job state

tests.name: Two-Phase Artifact Commit Protocol
tests.description: Verify metadata claims COMPLETED only after binary glTF is validated and durable on disk

tests.name: Pre-Commit Corrupted GLB Rejection
tests.description: Verify invalid binary glTF headers are rejected before filesystem commit

tests.name: Worker Crash Recovery & Successful Retry
tests.description: Verify job crashed during execution is recovered by supervisor and completed by worker 2

tests.name: Cooperative Cancellation Across Stages
tests.description: Verify cancellation succeeds in QUEUED/CLAIMED and is rejected in COMPLETED
